question: Break down revenue by business segment (Consumer & Community Banking, Corporate & Investment Bank, Commercial Banking, Asset & Wealth Management).

answer.summary: JPMorgan Chase organizes its activities into four major reportable business segments plus a Corporate segment [T00038]. For FY2024, the Corporate & Investment Bank generated the largest revenue at $102.00B [F09082], followed by Consumer & Community Banking at $54.50B [F09080], Commercial Banking at $30.00B [F09083], and Asset & Wealth Management at $15.50B [F09085]. Consumer & Community Banking declined 1.8% YoY to $54.50B [F09080], while Asset & Wealth Management declined 8.8% YoY to $15.50B [F09085]; Commercial Banking was flat at $30.00B (+0.0% YoY) [F09083]. The Corporate segment added $98.50B in FY2024 [F09087]. The consolidated total reported in the filing is FY2023 at $158.10B [F06769], so the FY2024 segment values cannot be reconciled to it within the retrieved evidence.
